facts.fact: StackAdapt announced on January 26, 2021 that it was named to the 2021 Best Workplaces for Start-Ups list, based on an analysis by Great Place to Work.
facts.quote: StackAdapt received this honour after a thorough and independent analysis conducted by Great Place to Work®.

facts.fact: The Great Place to Work 2021 Best Workplaces for Start-Ups list is based on employee feedback from hundreds of surveyed organizations, with the data stated to have a 90% confidence level.
facts.quote: The data has a 90% confidence and a plus or minus 5% margin of error.

facts.fact: To be eligible for the 2021 Best Workplaces for Start-Ups list, organizations must have been Great Place to Work-Certified within the past year.
facts.quote: organizations must be Great Place to Work- Certified™ in the past year, headquartered in Canada and fit our definition of a start-up

facts.fact: Great Place to Work defines a start-up for the 2021 Best Workplaces for Start-Ups list as typically less than five years in business and still looking for a scalable business model.
facts.quote: fit our definition of a start-up (typically less than five years in business and still looking for a scalable business model).
